description: This file implements an Android local bound service named 'LocalService'. It manages notifications and provides an interface (via Binder) for clients within the same process to bind and interact with the service. The class manages lifecycle methods such as onCreate, onStartCommand, onDestroy, and onBind, and includes functionality to show notifications and control service state.

classes.name: LocalService
classes.description: An Android Service class that runs locally within the same process, managing notifications and providing bound service functionality.

classes.name: LocalBinder
classes.description: Inner class that extends Binder to provide a way for clients to get a reference to the LocalService instance.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the NotificationManager and shows a notification indicating the service has started.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles service start requests and logs the start ID and intent.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels the notification and shows a toast indicating the service has stopped.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder object for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification indicating the service is running, with an intent to launch an activity when clicked.
